verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server on its developer-resources site; a probe confirmed it, and the page states it lets developers use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform, so an agent can connect through it. The evidence is only a single summary sentence plus a probe confirmation, with no detail on the tools exposed, setup or auth, or coverage of the Platforms APIs specifically. missing for 10: documented tool list and Platforms-specific API coverage, setup/authentication instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
